## LLM008 Empty catch swallows IOException

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | warning |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://pgy763.github.io/llm-dev-pitfalls/java/客户端断开后还在写SSE |
| Turn it off | `LLM008: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM008` on the command line |

Doing nothing in the catch treats a failed write as a successful one. A dropped connection is invisible, the log stays clean, and the user is left with half a sentence.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM008` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm008 -->

## What it looks like

`catch (IOException e) { }` around `emitter.send(...)` or a writer inside a streaming method.

## How to fix

Log it and finish the stream. A silent catch hides a client that is already gone and leaves the connection open.
